Beatmania GB - Gotcha Mix 2.name: Beatmania GB Gotcha Mix 2
Beatmania GB - Gotcha Mix 2.summary: Beatmania GB Gotcha Mix 2 is a videogame launched for Game Boy Color. It has 25 songs and it's the last portable videogame for beatmania franchise, and it's the only one from the trilogy to have "Duet" charts, which two players are needed to play this level via Game Boy link cable, two GBC's, and two copies of the same game.

Hunter x Hunter - Hunter no Keifu.name: Hunter X Hunter: Hunter no Keifu
Hunter x Hunter - Hunter no Keifu.summary: Hunter X Hunter: Hunter no Keifu is a Japanese strategy game for the Game Boy Color.

Super Jacked Up Tomato Face Johnson.name: Super Jacked Up Tomato Face Johnson
Super Jacked Up Tomato Face Johnson.summary: Super Jacked Up Tomato Face Johnson is a fast paced twitch platformer made for the Game Boy Color. There's a new protein shake fresh on the shelves and Tomato Face Johnson needs to bulk up! It's on the pricey side of course, but luckily, it's on sale for a limited time...
